series.title: 主从复制延迟：大事务与回放磁盘竞争
series.service: orders read service / PostgreSQL streaming replication
series.premise: 订单物理流复制副本延迟上升，用户写后读看不到新状态。主库健康，先控制一致性敏感读，再对照WAL发送、接收、回放位置。
series.outcome: 确认已提交的大批删除产生大量WAL，副本本地校验扫描加重磁盘竞争。暂停后续批次并降低扫描负载，验证回放追平后分批恢复读路由，不提升落后副本。交接监控并安排分批清理和资源隔离。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 副本正在追赶主库进度

recycling.note: 后续回访为候选安排，不计实际复现；引用不依赖并行草稿。

dialogues.title: 副本延迟不是主库宕机
dialogues.premise: 副本延迟告警触发，订单页面出现旧状态。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别主库健康和副本落后的不同影响。

lines.en: Replication lag is climbing on replica B. It's roughly ninety seconds behind now.
lines.zh: B副本复制延迟正在上升，现在大约落后九十秒。

lines.en: What does that number measure exactly? Time lag alone can mislead us.
lines.zh: 这个数字具体测什么？只看时间延迟可能误导。

lines.en: Customers see old paid order states. New writes still succeed on primary.
lines.zh: 客户看到已付款订单的旧状态，主库新写入仍成功。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, primary stays healthy, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。确认一下，主库仍健康，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, from current write latency checks. Don't promote a lagging replica blindly.
lines.zh: 从当前写延迟检查看是的，不要盲目提升落后副本。

lines.en: Let me tail the log now. I'll compare receive and replay positions.
lines.zh: 我现在盯日志，对比接收和回放位置。

lines.en: I'll verify a known committed order. We need a concrete freshness check.
lines.zh: 我核验一笔已知提交的订单，需要具体的新鲜度检查。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for routing options? Maybe two minutes before we decide.
lines.zh: 那读路由方案预计多久？也许两分钟后决策。

lines.en: Check spare primary capacity before shifting. A healthy writer can still overload.
lines.zh: 切换前检查主库余量，健康的写库也可能被压过载。

lines.en: I'm on it for traffic classes. Payment confirmation reads need priority first.
lines.zh: 我负责划分流量，支付确认读取需要优先处理。

dialogues.title: 哪些读不能容忍旧数据
dialogues.premise: 主库写入正常，副本旧状态影响订单确认，先分类读请求。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出写后读和可延迟报表的不同要求。

lines.en: Payment confirmation needs read-after-write consistency here. Historical reports can tolerate older results.
lines.zh: 支付确认这里要求写后读一致性，历史报表可以容忍较旧结果。

lines.en: What about customer order status pages? They also follow fresh writes frequently.
lines.zh: 客户订单状态页呢？它也经常紧跟新写入。

lines.en: You're right, include those pages too. That's our blast radius for stale reads.
lines.zh: 你说得对，状态页也算进去，这是旧数据读取的影响范围。

lines.en: Just to confirm, not every report, right? We shouldn't shift all reads blindly.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不是所有报表，对吧？不能盲目把所有读都切过去。

lines.en: Agreed. Mark delayed reports clearly instead. Never label old data as current.
lines.zh: 同意，给延迟报表明确标记，不能把旧数据标成当前数据。

lines.en: Replication lag is climbing beyond two minutes. Maybe replay can't match incoming changes.
lines.zh: 复制延迟已上升超过两分钟，可能回放赶不上新变更。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on primary. Limit sensitive reads if capacity tightens.
lines.zh: 我观察主库，容量紧张就限制敏感读的接纳量。

lines.en: A full failover? Let's park that. We have no writer failure evidence.
lines.zh: 全量故障切主先放一边，没有证据证明写库故障。

lines.en: Also check cached status responses carefully. Routing alone won't clear stale caches.
lines.zh: 还要仔细检查状态响应缓存，改路由不会清掉旧缓存。

lines.en: Okay, compare the positions next then. That should separate transport from replay.
lines.zh: 好，那下一步对比位置，以区分传输和回放问题。

dialogues.title: 日志收到，回放落后
dialogues.premise: 敏感读范围明确，开始对照主库发送和副本接收回放进度。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听懂收到日志不等于已能读到其数据。

lines.en: The replay position trails received WAL. Primary sends and B receives promptly.
lines.zh: 回放位置落后于已接收WAL，主库发送和B接收都及时。

lines.en: Then received logs aren't readable data yet. Replay must apply their changes first.
lines.zh: 那收到的日志还不等于可读数据，必须先回放应用变更。

lines.en: That fits the stale order samples. Read-after-write consistency fails on B currently.
lines.zh: 这符合订单旧状态样本，B目前无法满足写后读一致性。

lines.en: Okay, network failure looks unlikely, right? Can we rule that out entirely?
lines.zh: 好，网络故障看来不太可能，对吧？能完全排除吗？

lines.en: Not entirely, just this observed bottleneck. Current receive progress doesn't show transport stalls.
lines.zh: 不能完全排除，只能针对当前瓶颈判断，当前接收进度没显示传输卡顿。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is slow apply. B's disk queue rose around nine.
lines.zh: 当前假设是应用日志慢，B的磁盘队列在九点左右上升。

lines.en: Check replay conflicts and local jobs. Disk pressure could have several causes.
lines.zh: 查回放冲突和本地任务，磁盘压力可能有多种原因。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for correlation? About three minutes would be useful.
lines.zh: 那关联证据预计多久？三分钟左右就有帮助。

lines.en: I'll compare primary WAL generation rates. We need both sides of this.
lines.zh: 我对比主库WAL生成速率，两边证据都需要。

lines.en: I'm on it for routing preparation. No live switch until capacity checks pass.
lines.zh: 我准备路由，容量检查通过之前不在线切换。

dialogues.title: 大批删除与本地扫描重叠
dialogues.premise: 副本收到日志但回放慢，查主库WAL增长和副本磁盘任务。
dialogues.listeningTask: 分清已提交事务、后续批次与回放负载。

lines.en: A large transaction deleted archived rows. It generated about two gigabytes of WAL.
lines.zh: 一个大事务删除归档行，产生大约两GB的WAL。

lines.en: Has that transaction committed already now? Killing it won't undo committed work.
lines.zh: 这个事务现在已经提交了吗？杀掉它不能撤销已提交工作。

lines.en: Yes, the audit shows successful commit. The scheduler has another batch queued.
lines.zh: 是，审计显示提交成功，调度器还有下一批待执行。

lines.en: Just to confirm, pause future batches, right? We aren't cancelling completed transactions.
lines.zh: 确认一下，暂停后续批次，对吧？不是取消已完成事务。

lines.en: Let me tail the log too. B started a local checksum scan.
lines.zh: 我也盯日志，B同时启动了本地校验扫描。

lines.en: The replay position advanced more slowly then. No replay conflict errors are logged.
lines.zh: 当时回放位置推进变慢，日志没有回放冲突错误。

lines.en: So disk competition is worth testing. Don't change replication settings without evidence.
lines.zh: 所以值得验证磁盘竞争，没证据别改复制设置。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis combines both loads. Maybe the scan worsens that WAL burst.
lines.zh: 当前假设是两种负载叠加，扫描可能加重了WAL突增的影响。

lines.en: Check job timestamps against disk metrics. Correlation isn't the whole causal proof.
lines.zh: 把任务时间戳和磁盘指标对照，相关不等于完整因果证明。

lines.en: Okay, the root cause is still open. Control sensitive reads before that test.
lines.zh: 好，根因仍未定，验证前先控制敏感读。

dialogues.title: 只把敏感读送往主库
dialogues.premise: 已提交大删除与扫描重叠，主库容量检查通过，准备切敏感读。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住读流量范围、缓存策略和停止条件。

lines.en: Route reads to the primary selectively. Start with payment confirmation on canary.
lines.zh: 有选择地把读送到主库，先灰度支付确认。

lines.en: The capacity check passed at this rate. Keep admission limits for traffic spikes.
lines.zh: 这个速率的容量检查通过，仍保留流量突增时的接纳限额。

lines.en: Read-after-write consistency also needs cache bypass. Those endpoints won't serve cached states.
lines.zh: 写后读一致性还需要绕过缓存，这些端点不再返回缓存状态。

lines.en: Validate a new committed order first. Then expand customer status reads gradually.
lines.zh: 先验证一笔新提交订单，再逐步扩展客户状态读取。

lines.en: Just to confirm, B stays a replica, right? No promotion changes in this incident.
lines.zh: 确认一下，B仍是副本，对吧？这次不做提升切主。

lines.en: Correct. Writer latency is our rollback trigger. Stop expansion if it gets worse.
lines.zh: 对，写延迟是回退触发条件，变差就停止扩展。

lines.en: Okay, shed load from optional reports. Maybe defer them rather than overload primary.
lines.zh: 好，减掉非必要报表负载，宁可延后也别压垮主库。

lines.en: Don't send sensitive reads back blindly. If primary overloads, restrict that feature.
lines.zh: 别盲目把敏感读送回副本，主库过载就限制该功能。

lines.en: I'm on it for the canary. I'll verify freshness and useful throughput.
lines.zh: 我负责灰度，验证数据新鲜度和有效吞吐。

lines.en: So, I'll pause the next deletion. That reduces fresh WAL without stopping replication.
lines.zh: 那我暂停下一批删除，减少新WAL但不停复制。

dialogues.title: 给回放让出磁盘资源
dialogues.premise: 敏感读已分批转主库，后续删除暂停，验证扫描对副本回放的影响。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解降低竞争任务负载不等于随意调复制参数。

lines.en: The replay bottleneck appears disk related. I'll throttle the local checksum scan.
lines.zh: 回放瓶颈看来与磁盘有关，我降低本地校验扫描速率。

lines.en: Is that scan safe to throttle? Check its owner's procedure before changing.
lines.zh: 扫描能安全降速吗？变更前查任务负责人的流程。

lines.en: The owner approved its lower rate. Results stay incomplete until it finishes.
lines.zh: 负责人批准降低速率，扫描完成前结果仍是不完整的。

lines.en: Okay, change that workload alone, right? We need a meaningful before-and-after comparison.
lines.zh: 好，只改这项负载，对吧？要有有意义的前后对比。

lines.en: Keep replication enabled and settings unchanged. This isn't evidence for extra apply threads.
lines.zh: 复制保持启用且参数不变，这不是增加回放线程的依据。

lines.en: The large transaction still needs replay. Lower disk waits should help it progress.
lines.zh: 大事务日志仍需要回放，降低磁盘等待应有助于推进。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on throughput. Compare replay position with incoming WAL too.
lines.zh: 我观察吞吐，也把回放位置和新到WAL对照。

lines.en: What's the ETA for a trend? Maybe five minutes before judging this.
lines.zh: 预计多久看到趋势？也许五分钟后再判断。

lines.en: That's sensible, but don't promise catch-up. Remaining WAL volume affects recovery time.
lines.zh: 合理，但别承诺追平，剩余WAL量会影响恢复时间。

lines.en: So, label this a temporary workaround. The batch scheduling fix comes later.
lines.zh: 那把它标成临时缓解，批次调度修复后面再做。

dialogues.title: 追赶趋势与真正追平
dialogues.premise: 扫描降速后磁盘等待下降，开始核验回放速度及订单新鲜度。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分正在追赶、达到固定标记和持续稳定。

lines.en: The replica is catching up now. Replay runs faster than new WAL arrives.
lines.zh: 副本现在正在追赶，回放速度超过新WAL到达速度。

lines.en: Good trend, but show the remaining gap. A falling timer isn't enough proof.
lines.zh: 趋势不错，但要展示剩余差距，计时数下降不足以证明。

lines.en: The byte gap is shrinking too. Our known order appears on B.
lines.zh: 字节差距也在缩小，已知订单已出现在B。

lines.en: Just to confirm, newer orders too, right? One old marker doesn't prove freshness.
lines.zh: 确认一下，也查更新的订单，对吧？一个旧标记不能证明新鲜度。

lines.en: I'll compare newly committed markers repeatedly. Record primary positions with each check.
lines.zh: 我反复对比新提交标记，每次都记录对应主库位置。

lines.en: The replay position reached our latest marker. About ten seconds behind current writes.
lines.zh: 回放位置达到最新测试标记，离当前写入大约还有十秒。

lines.en: Let it catch up before restoring traffic. Keep primary routing for sensitive reads.
lines.zh: 恢复流量前让它继续追平，敏感读仍走主库。

lines.en: So, let's keep it under observation. Maybe five stable minutes after matching markers.
lines.zh: 那继续观察，标记匹配后再稳定观察五分钟左右。

lines.en: Include disk queues and replay errors. Fresh samples alone miss recurring pressure.
lines.zh: 也检查磁盘队列和回放错误，只有新鲜样本会漏掉复发压力。

lines.en: If replication lag is climbing again, stop. I'll keep the routing change ready.
lines.zh: 如果复制延迟再上升就停止，我会保留路由变更准备。

dialogues.title: 先恢复可容忍延迟的读
dialogues.premise: 多次提交标记匹配且稳定五分钟，准备分批恢复副本读流量。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清敏感读仍走主库，恢复不是一次全切。

lines.en: We can restore read routing gradually. Start with delay-tolerant historical report traffic.
lines.zh: 可以逐步恢复读路由，先从容忍延迟的历史报表流量开始。

lines.en: Payment confirmations still need stronger guarantees. Low lag isn't a consistency contract.
lines.zh: 支付确认仍需要更强保证，低延迟不是一致性契约。

lines.en: Yes, read-after-write consistency keeps primary routing. B has fresh markers, not synchronous guarantees.
lines.zh: 是，写后读一致性仍走主库，B有新标记但没有同步保证。

lines.en: Just to confirm, one class first, right? Maybe twenty percent of historical reads.
lines.zh: 确认一下，先一种请求，对吧？可先恢复百分之二十历史读。

lines.en: That's within the tested load range. Watch replay during each routing step.
lines.zh: 这在已测负载范围内，每次调整路由都观察回放。

lines.en: I'm on it for staged routing. Sensitive endpoints still route reads to the primary.
lines.zh: 我负责分阶段路由，敏感端点仍把读送主库。

lines.en: What's the rollback trigger for B? Use byte backlog and freshness together.
lines.zh: B的回退触发条件是什么？同时用字节积压和新鲜度判断。

lines.en: Sustained lag or failed markers means stop. Reduce replica reads while we investigate.
lines.zh: 持续延迟或标记失败就停止，排查期间减少副本读。

lines.en: Keep writer protection active during fallback. Don't suddenly flood the primary either.
lines.zh: 回退期间继续保护写库，也别突然把流量灌满主库。

lines.en: Okay, record each batch and result. We need that for tonight's handoff.
lines.zh: 好，记录每批及结果，今晚交接需要这些。

dialogues.title: 读路由恢复后的值守阈值
dialogues.premise: 历史读已分批恢复且稳定，敏感读仍走主库，删除批次继续暂停。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住升级条件和不可自动执行的切主操作。

lines.en: The lag threshold is thirty seconds. Page us after two consecutive breaches.
lines.zh: 延迟阈值三十秒，连续两次超过就呼叫我们。

lines.en: And failed freshness checks need immediate attention. Even when that timer looks normal.
lines.zh: 新鲜度检查失败也要立即关注，即使计时数看起来正常。

lines.en: Okay, hand over those checks tonight. The escalation path lists Raj first.
lines.zh: 好，今晚交接这些检查，升级路径第一联系人是Raj。

lines.en: What if primary write health changes? That needs a separate failover assessment.
lines.zh: 如果主库写健康变化呢？那需要单独评估故障切换。

lines.en: Yes, no automatic promotion for lag. We retain routing controls instead, right?
lines.zh: 是，不因延迟自动提升副本，而是保留路由控制，对吧？

lines.en: Correct, keep an eye on both loads. The replica is catching up under bursts.
lines.zh: 对，两边负载都关注，副本在突发后仍能追赶。

lines.en: The scan remains throttled for now. Who approves its normal rate later?
lines.zh: 扫描目前仍降速，之后谁批准恢复正常速率？

lines.en: Its owner, after a load review. What's the ETA for that review?
lines.zh: 任务负责人，负载评审后批准，评审预计何时？

lines.en: Tomorrow morning, with overlapping workloads measured. Maybe isolate the scan from B.
lines.zh: 明早，带上重叠负载测量结果，也许把扫描和B隔离。

lines.en: So, I'll attach current routing settings. Reports and confirmations have different destinations.
lines.zh: 那我附上当前路由设置，报表和确认读取目的地不同。

dialogues.title: 拆批次，也拆开竞争负载
dialogues.premise: 夜班观察稳定，复盘WAL突增及扫描降速前后的回放证据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别已支持的原因与尚需负载测试的改进。

lines.en: We'll batch the deletes from now. The large transaction caused the WAL burst.
lines.zh: 之后把删除拆成批次，大事务造成这次WAL突增。

lines.en: Disk waits fell after scan throttling. Replay accelerated with the same incoming rate.
lines.zh: 扫描降速后磁盘等待下降，在相同日志输入速率下回放加快。

lines.en: That supports disk competition as a contributor. It doesn't blame the scan alone.
lines.zh: 这支持磁盘竞争是一个促成因素，不是把责任全归扫描。

lines.en: So, who's picking this up tomorrow? Raj owns batch sizing tests, right?
lines.zh: 那明天谁接？Raj负责批次大小测试，对吧？

lines.en: I'll own scan isolation options Friday. Moving it elsewhere has capacity costs.
lines.zh: 我周五负责扫描隔离方案，迁到别处也有容量成本。

lines.en: Yes, my action item includes pacing. Maybe row count alone isn't enough.
lines.zh: 是，我的行动项也包括批次节奏，可能只限制行数还不够。

lines.en: Measure WAL volume and replay bottleneck together. Test overlaps in an isolated environment.
lines.zh: 同时测WAL量和回放瓶颈，在隔离环境测试负载重叠。

lines.en: I'll test freshness-aware routing by Friday. Sensitive reads remain on primary meanwhile.
lines.zh: 我周五前测试感知新鲜度的路由，期间敏感读仍走主库。

lines.en: Keep failover policy separate from lag routing. Promotion requires durability and fencing checks.
lines.zh: 故障切主策略与延迟读路由分开，提升副本需要持久性和隔离旧主检查。

lines.en: Okay, close the loop next week. Bring overlap tests and routing evidence.
lines.zh: 好，下周闭环，带上重叠负载测试和路由证据。
